description: Implementation of the FramebufferNULL class methods for a null renderer in the ANGLE project, handling framebuffer operations such as discard, invalidate, clear, readPixels, and status checks.

classes.name: FramebufferNULL
classes.description: A null implementation of a framebuffer for the ANGLE renderer, providing stub methods that simulate framebuffer operations without actual GPU resource management.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Stub method for discarding framebuffer attachments, returns continue result.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Stub method for invalidating framebuffer attachments, returns continue result.

methods.name: invalidateSub
methods.description: Stub method for invalidating a sub-region of the framebuffer, returns continue result.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Stub method for clearing the framebuffer, returns continue result.

methods.name: clearBufferfv
methods.description: Stub method for clearing a buffer with float values, returns continue result.

methods.name: clearBufferuiv
methods.description: Stub method for clearing a buffer with unsigned int values, returns continue result.

methods.name: clearBufferiv
methods.description: Stub method for clearing a buffer with int values, returns continue result.

methods.name: clearBufferfi
methods.description: Stub method for clearing depth/stencil buffers, returns continue result.

methods.name: getImplementationColorReadFormat
methods.description: Returns the format used for reading pixels from the framebuffer attachment.

methods.name: getImplementationColorReadType
methods.description: Returns the data type used for reading pixels from the framebuffer attachment.

methods.name: readPixels
methods.description: Simulates reading pixels from the framebuffer, filling the buffer with dummy data.

methods.name: blit
methods.description: Stub method for blitting (copying) framebuffer content, returns continue result.

methods.name: checkStatus
methods.description: Always returns true, indicating the framebuffer is considered complete.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Stub method for synchronizing state, returns continue result.

methods.name: getSamplePosition
methods.description: Stub method for retrieving sample positions, returns continue result.
